demoSeeds: public demonstration keys, never real ones

verdicts.claim: The end of a log is anchored: across the 1,000 bundles, every one-line edit (a changed field, a removed line, two adjacent lines swapped), every cut of the last 1 to 5 lines, and every whole log rewritten with fresh hashes by someone without the recorder's key fails verification; every untouched bundle verifies.
verdicts.measured: 1000 of 1000 untouched bundles verified; 71205 of 71205 attacks on their logs refused (one-line edits, tail cuts of 1 to 5 lines, whole logs rewritten with fresh hashes)

verdicts.claim: Forgery is refused: for each of the 1,000, a bundle re-signed with the attacker's key, a recorder signature moved onto another job's record, a judge's signature over a judgement a re-run does not give, and a reviewer's decisions moved onto another record are each refused.
verdicts.measured: refused, of 1000 each: the attacker’s key 1000, signatures moved onto another job 1000, a judgement a re-run does not give 450, a reviewer’s decisions moved 1000

verdicts.claim: The judgement re-runs: for every one of the 1,000, judging the record again gives byte for byte the judgement whose hash the judge signed.
verdicts.measured: 1000 of 1000 judgements re-ran byte for byte to the hash the judge signed

verdicts.claim: Keys stay private: no private key, in any form it is held (raw, PKCS#8, hex or base64), appears in any record, log, bundle or receipt the measurement writes.
verdicts.measured: private-key forms found in 1000 bundles and the receipt: 0

verdicts.claim: Organ 2's gap is closed on real jobs: on the 31 real logs (on this machine), once signed, every one-line edit and every cut of the last line fails verification, including the kind organ 2's chain alone missed.
verdicts.measured: 31 real logs signed (31 verified untouched): 5807 of 5807 attacks refused; the cut of the last line, which organ 2’s chain alone missed, refused 31 of 31
